about.body: The N63TU is BMW's twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 petrol engine, a technical update to the original N63 with improved components. In production since 2012, it's found in the 6 Series 650i and the 7 Series 750i. Unlike BMW's inline-six engines, the N63TU follows a hot-vee design — with the turbochargers positioned inside the V between the cylinder banks — a layout that's distinctive and requires specific workshop knowledge during a rebuild.

byModel.body: Across the 6 Series, the N63TU powers the 650i in the F06/F12/F13 generation from 2012 to 2018. The 7 Series carries the same engine in the 750i across the G11/G12 generation from 2015 to 2022.

compatibility.body: The N63TU was introduced as an improved version of the N63, addressing earlier design concerns. While the base engine code is shared between the 6 Series and 7 Series applications, ancillaries and mounting differ between models — we confirm compatibility by registration/VIN before any rebuild or replacement work begins.
